scope: Experiment audit script review only; no product code or frozen runtime changed. Synthetic mutations validate record-consistency checks, not simulator correctness.

targeted_checks.case: recovery before full fresh dwell rejected
early fall cannot explain truncation after pulse deadline
inclusive Torch float32 threshold equality preserved

limitations: Pose extrema and wrench verification are runtime exports, not independently read sensor/PhysX data.
No raw-frame reconstruction of continuous stable dwell, or final angular velocity, roll/pitch and height.
Pulse timing/count checks use the recorded control dt and expected substep count; physics dt is not independently reconstructed.
Fall labels use exported extrema and the same strict threshold ordering as episode_records; this is not a new outcome definition.
